The challenge is sustaining interest once the initial pursuit is complete, staying engaged when the relationship becomes maintenance rather than conquest.
PLCMT_VENUS_ARIES.behavioral: You pursue what you want, express desire directly, and need relationships that stay exciting. When you're attracted to someone, you make it obvious. When you want something, you go after it. Your relational style is active and competitive. You enjoy the chase more than the capture. This isn't game-playing. It's genuine passion for pursuit. You feel most alive when desire has somewhere to go. The shadow is that pursuit can become the only pleasure. You may lose interest once you've won, or you may create conflict to maintain excitement. The work is finding ways to stay engaged in relationships that have moved past conquest into partnership.
